data.summary: Under --json a parser usage error (missing required argument, unknown command or flag: 'ddflow --json show', 'ddflow --json complete', 'ddflow --json nosuchcommand', 'ddflow --json ci --item X') exits 2 with usage on stderr and nothing on stdout: argparse exits inside parser.parse_args (cli.py:342), before remembered_streams and the refusal_body fallback, and tests/test_json_body_on_every_exit.py skips any stderr starting with usage:. A front end (r-external-frontends) reads an empty body at exit 2. Found closing B-json-failures (research Ra0ae26e9df); the exit-1 FAIL path that item named is fixed.
data.title: --json usage errors print no JSON body

data.reason: Already fixed on main, not by this item: e9af66ec3 (fix-Bac9d773a44, bug Bac9d773a44, 2026-10-15) added one fallback at the CLI entry, refusal_body in ddflow/surfaces/cli.py main(), so every --json run that exits non-zero without printing answers a JSON body, instead of the per-command helper this item proposed. data.summary: ddflow verify judges a done task against the CURRENT task_pipeline, not the pipeline at completion, so a task completed before the ci gate existed is reported [FAIL] gates never run and never skipped: ci and 'does not hold'. Eight of 21 BL-from-mining tasks (B22 B-parallel-tests B17 B23 B-cadence-phase-close B-docs-phase-gate B16 B26) FAIL on this alone: a false 'does not hold' (exit 1) buries real failures. R-verify-pipeline-retro CONFIRMED the mechanism on 2026-10-05 and no bug was ever filed. The completion ledger should store its pipeline, or verify should consult the gates configured at the completion time.
data.title: verify fails old completions for a gate added after they completed
